_source: Background.vb, Textures.vb, Cube.vb, Form1.vb (UNI-T40). loadBackground builds one setupVertex quad bgWidth (1.2) across from its left edge and bgHeight (0.415) above and below its centre line; renderBackground draws it at Matrix.Translation(-0.56, 0, 0) with texBackground, which loadTextures sets to areaBeach (gfx/area/beach.png); Form1.vb's B sets it to areaBeach and N to areaUtopia (gfx/area/utopia.png), and no Reset touches it. Every area is loaded at 512 x 512, so the whole picture is stretched over the quad. Screen units, y up (space.json maps them). Before it, renderCube draws Cube.vb's unit cube scaled 67 x 55 x 38 around the camera with texCube1 (gfx/brick.jpg): the room the background stands in.

areas._about: Every picture of gfx/area, by name, as the file Assets/Unity.Rea.Chain/Art/Background holds it. beach and utopia are the two Textures.vb loads; the rest sit in the folder unused (512.JPG imported lowercased as 512.jpg; the Copy of landscape.jpg files are duplicates and not imported).

cube._about: Cube.vb: matCube1 = Matrix.Scaling(67, 55, 38) on a unit cube centred on the origin, texCube1 = gfx/brick.jpg (as Assets/Unity.Rea.Chain/Art/Room holds it) stretched once over each face.
